description: An astrophotographer's gallery profile: display name, bio and avatar. One per repository, at record key `self`.

main.description: The author's gallery profile. Derived from the users row (name, bio, image). Exactly one per repository, so the key is the literal `self` as in app.bsky.actor.profile.

displayName.description: Name shown on the gallery. From users.name.

avatar.description: Profile picture, at most 2 MB. Replaces users.image (which is a URL in the database).

createdAt.description: When the profile was first written (RFC 3339 with time zone). From users.created_at.
